title: fix(app-shell): Studio Access pillar polish — plain-words draft race refusal, OWD banner clears on revert, live rail label, field table count and pinned name column
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8SS6ia75ydEcRpPoKXe7Wi8)_
Fixes #26846

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 访问(Access)支柱四处小修:草稿抢先创建时的拒绝改成作者能懂的话;OWD 总览撤回改动后拒绝提示随之消失;权限集改名后左侧列表立即显示新标签;字段子表的「可见/总数」计数挪到筛选框旁、字段名列横向滚动时固定在左侧。第五项(恢复已忽略的建议绑定)服务端没有对应接口,本 PR 不做,交席位立服务端卡。
- 为什么改:QA 在一次 Studio 巡检里实测到这五处,单个都小,合起来让访问支柱显得不可靠(卡 #26846,分诊 p3)。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `@object-ui/app-shell` 三个组件与 `@object-ui/i18n` 新增一个键,无契约、无服务端改动;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`(AccessPillar 的创建拒绝映射与矩阵保存后重读列表)、`PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx`(回到无改动时清除拒绝)、`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`(字段子表的计数位置与固定列)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageOwdOverviewPanel.refusalClearsOnRevert-26846.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.accessRailLabelLive-26846.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.fieldTableLayout-26846.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.accessCreateTaken-26836.test.tsx`,预期 4 个文件、15 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Each item was re-reproduced on `origin/main` `07d18e69` first (the QA run was at `3fcafcd3`).

1. **Duplicate-draft refusal in plain words (item 1, narrowed).** The card's path no longer reproduces: since #26836 the Access "+ New" reads `findTakenIdentifier` before its save and refuses a taken identifier with an author-facing notice, writing nothing. The server's first-write-pin sentence still reached the dialog in the window between that check and the save, and the existing race test pinned it verbatim. `AccessPillar.doCreate` now reads that refusal by its code: this create always sends the pin (`ifNoneMatch: '*'`), so `METADATA_CONFLICT` means the identifier holds a draft, and the dialog shows `engine.studio.access.createDraftTaken` (en + zh, new in `@object-ui/i18n`). Any other refusal keeps its own text. The server message is unchanged.
2. **OWD refusal banner outlives its revert (item 2).** The refusal state lives in `PackageOwdOverviewPanel` (the Access pillar's sharing-baseline overview), not in `PermissionMatrixEditor`. Its `saveError` now clears on the dirty-to-clean transition, when every row is back at its loaded value ("No changes"). A row that is still dirty keeps the banner.
3. **Stale set label in the Access rail (item 3).** The matrix page's `onDraftSaved` in `AccessPillar` updated only the draft-name set; the rail list was read on mount, publish and the live-metadata pulse. That callback now also calls the pillar's own `load()`, so a label an autosave changed shows at once, with no polling.
4. **Clipped field counter, non-sticky name column (item 4).** The studio matrix has a `min-w-[1304px]` floor, wider than the Studio content column beside the rail at 1440 px, so the field sub-table's `ml-auto` counter sat past the visible edge of the scroll container. The counter now sits right after the field filter (`shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap`), and the field-name header and cells carry `FIELD_NAME_CELL` (`sticky left-0 z-[1] bg-background`), so the column stays in view while the matrix scrolls sideways. The sub-table is shared, so the non-Studio matrix page gets the same.
5. **No re-grant for a dismissed suggestion (item 5): left out.** Measured: the server exposes only `GET /security/suggested-bindings`, `POST …/:id/confirm` and `POST …/:id/dismiss`; `confirmAudienceBindingSuggestion` in plugin-security refuses any row whose status is not `pending` ("only pending suggestions can be accepted"), and no route re-opens a dismissed row. Per the dispatch order no endpoint is invented here; the seat can file a server-side card.

## Why

Five small Access-pillar defects measured in one Studio QA pass (#26846). Triage graded them p3 together: "One PR is fine."

## Tests

All at head `8220f32d` (after merging `origin/main`, which brought #26999 into the same two files).

- New `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.refusalClearsOnRevert-26846.test.tsx`: a revert to the loaded value clears the banner; CONTROL: a still-dirty edit keeps it.
- New `StudioDesignSurface.accessRailLabelLive-26846.test.tsx`: the real `AccessPillar` with a matrix stand-in that reports one draft save; the rail row goes from "Dispatcher" to "Dispatcher v2".
- New `PermissionMatrixEditor.fieldTableLayout-26846.test.tsx`: the count is the filter's next sibling and has no `ml-auto`; the name header and every name cell carry the pinned classes; CONTROL: a box cell is not sticky. jsdom lays nothing out, so this pins structure and classes, not pixels.
- Updated `StudioDesignSurface.accessCreateTaken-26836.test.tsx`: the race test now expects the author-facing sentence and the absence of the pin sentence; a new CONTROL keeps a `VALIDATION_ERROR` refusal's own text.

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

- The four files: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 15 passed (15)` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- Every app-shell test file naming `PermissionMatrixEdit`, `AccessPillar`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel` or an `engine.studio.access.` key (65 files): `Test Files 65 passed (65)`, `Tests 595 passed (595)` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0, 5m37s).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` exit 0; `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:scripts` exit 0.
- Ablations, one per behaviour, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with the restore proved by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`:
  - item 1, the `METADATA_CONFLICT` test replaced by `false`: the race test fails, 9 others pass.
  - item 2, the clear replaced by `void 0;`: the revert test fails, its CONTROL passes.
  - item 3, the `void load();` deleted: the rail-label test fails. (A first attempt that replaced the line was refused by the tool before any run, the replacement count not rising; the delete form ran.)
  - item 4, `FIELD_NAME_CELL` emptied: the pinned-column test fails, the counter test passes.
  - item 4, the counter's class put back to `ml-auto …`: the counter test fails, the pinned-column test passes.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Item 1: the card's reproduction no longer reproduces on main (#26836 added the pre-save check); only the check-to-save race reached the author, and that is what is mapped. Other Studio creates (flow, object, app, interfaces) share the same race shape and still show the door's sentence there; noted, not changed here.
- Item 3: the rail shows a PUBLISHED set by its published label and a draft-only set by its `_drafts` row label (ruling 6053526025, question 1). A label edit on a published set's pending draft therefore still shows the published label until publish; this PR does not change that reading.
- Item 4 was reasoned from the matrix's `min-w-[1304px]` floor against the Studio column width, not measured in a browser at 1440 x 900.

Also run outside the derivation: `pnpm check:changeset-fixed` exit 0 and `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations` exit 0 ("0 new citation(s)").
